text:
incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach potential on /v1/generate latency (p95 > 800ms) — firing in 2m. See: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1792345678 :rotating_light:

alex: Heads-up for evening handoff — p95 latency for text-gen is spiking again (started ~10m ago). I'm primary until 18:00PT, @maria you are secondary for the next hour. No major customer-facing errors yet but increased latency observed for some dedicated tenants.

maria: ack. grabbing quick context — is this the same pattern as yesterday?

alex: looks similar: CPU utilization on gpu-pool-3 jumps when sequence length > 2048, causing queuing. Canary traffic shows some retries. Root cause still unknown. I'm going to open the incident runbook and post the short play.

alex: Runbook excerpt: 
1) Verify model variants routing (console -> routing -> /v1/generate).
2) Check batch sizes and tail-latency metrics (grafana: infra/served/batching).
3) If noisy, temporarily relax alert threshold and create a silence for the noisy alert while we mitigate: 

Command to silence (Alertmanager):
```
curl -XPOST "https://alertmanager.redwood/api/v1/silences" -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"SLO_P95_Latency","isRegex":false}],"startsAt":"2026-10-12T01:00:00Z","endsAt":"2026-10-12T02:00:00Z","createdBy":"oncall","comment":"temp suppression during mitigation and handoff"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

alex: I will apply a 30m silence now targeting infra alerts for s4-staging and gpu-pool-3 only. Not touching production tenant alerts for top-tier customers.

incident-bot: NOTE: Silence created by alex — ID: s-7a1b2c (expires in 30m).

devon: quick Q — do we want to route heavy seqlength traffic to v2-model-small as fallback? That will reduce quality but keep latencies under SLO.

maria: If we do fallback, we need a canary and explicit flag to avoid global downgrade. Suggest: route 10% by policy -> v2-small and monitor errors for top customers.

alex: agree with cautious 10% fallback. I'll create a temporary routing policy in the console and annotate the rollout. Steps: 
- create rollout: name=slo-fallback-10pct
- target: model:v2-small
- policy: seq_len>1024 AND tenant NOT IN (tier=enterprise)
- duration: 30m then reassess

sarah: FYI I just pinged the account success team for two customers showing higher error rates. They asked for ETA and if we have a mitigation plan.

alex: told them 30m mitigation window, fallback + silences. Please keep them updated with any changes.

devon: I've queued the routing change as a canary. Applying now.

deploy-bot: ROUTE-ROLLOUT: slo-fallback-10pct -> IN PROGRESS. ID: rr-9921. 10% routed to model:v2-small.

maria: monitoring p95 and error-rate. p95 dropped from 920ms -> 610ms on canary traffic. throughput slightly lower but recovering.

alex: good. Next: we'll keep alert thresholds strict for enterprise tiers and relax infra SLO alerts for the noisy GPU pool only. I've updated Alertmanager matchers to include cluster=gpu-pool-3.

maria: also adding a Grafana dashboard annotation for the change so oncoming oncall sees it.

devon: quick note for handoff: I'm leaving in 20m; @maria you'll be primary at 18:00PT. If the fallback doesn't stabilize in 15m, escalate to eng-runtime (paging: @sarah).

maria: copy. I'll take primary. Where is the short checklist for next shift?

alex: pinned checklist (short):
- confirm silence ID s-7a1b2c is active and scoped correctly
- verify rr-9921 is still 10% and health of v2-small canary
- check gpu-pool-3 GPU saturation, preemptively scale if queue > 200
- if p95 stays > 800ms for > 20m for enterprise tenants -> remove silence and escalate to eng-runtime (pager)
- inform account success for customers with >5% error-rate spike

maria: thanks. I added that to the runbook notes and set a reminder at 18:10PT to review.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Silence s-7a1b2c expires in 20m.

devon: also, for audit, can someone log the exact tenants excluded from fallback? I'll attach the list to the incident.

alex: doing that now — uploading to incident ticket: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-4211/attachments

sarah: ping — I can jump in if routing change doesn't hold. Keep me in the loop.

maria: handoff note: I'm primary until 02:00PT, devon covering until 18:00PT, alex was primary for this window. Current state: canary healthy, silence active, enterprise SLOs still monitored (no full production degradation). Next steps: continue monitoring, prepare rollback plan for rr-9921 if errors increase.

devon: leaving. good handoff. :thumbsup:

maria: took primary — acknowledged. I'll post a short summary in #incidents after 18:15PT with final action items and whether we extend silences or open a follow-up action item for optimizing batch/kernel selection on gpu-pool-3.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: initial mitigation stable, silence expires in ~10m. Please reopen if customer impact increases.

maria: (final) reopening if p95 creeps back up or if account team reports issues. otherwise will create a follow-up RFC for permanent threshold tuning and routing safeguards.
